name: Impossible Dips
how_to:
Step 1: Setup and Starting Position
- Position yourself between two parallel bars at a comfortable shoulder-width distance.
- Grip the bars firmly and push yourself up into the top dip position.
- Keep your legs extended straight and maintain a hollow body position (engage your core to prevent sagging).
Step 2: Execution
1. Lower your body slowly and in a controlled manner, keeping your torso straight and slightly leaned forward.
2. Maintain full-body tension, ensuring your hips and legs do not drop.
3. Descend until your upper arms are parallel to the bars or slightly lower.
4. Push back up using triceps, shoulders, and core engagement while keeping your body rigid.
5. Complete 3 to 5 sets of 3 to 8 reps, depending on your strength level.
